d:
Diwali 2026 Flight Ticket Prices have skyrocketed on several routes, with fares from Bengaluru and Mumbai to Patna reaching over ₹25,000. As millions of Indians struggle to travel home for Diwali and Chhath Puja, the Supreme Court's “Don't Travel by Air” remark during a hearing has sparked fresh questions about expensive air travel in India.
Why are flight ticket prices so high during the festive season? Why is the government unwilling to impose a price cap? And if passengers are paying such high fares, why are Indian airlines reporting massive losses?
